messages:
Maria (Finance): Heads up — VendorX invoice 2026-05-01 (INV-2026-0421) includes an unexpected "SLA surcharge" line for Private deployment renewal. We never approved this. Attaching PDF in email thread. @Sam (Sales) @Tina (Customer Success) can you confirm whether this was negotiated with reseller? Need decision to pay/dispute by EOD Fri.

Sam (Sales): Hmm, we did agree to a support-tier bump for a few accounts last quarter, but I don't recall an SLA surcharge line item. I'll call the reseller now. :phone:

Tina (Customer Success): Customer reached out — they see a higher platform fee and asked for itemized breakdown. Do we have a signed amendment? I thought only the monthly platform fee changed.

Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-0421: line 4 "SLA premium" $6,000. Status: UNPAID. Action suggestion: HOLD. Use command: ` /invoice hold INV-2026-0421 --reason "dispute SLA surcharge" `

Jake (Legal): Quick check: is there an SOW amendment or signed change-order? If not, we should dispute. If reseller claims it's in our negotiated rates, get the email trail.

Sam (Sales): On the phone with reseller — they claim the surcharge covers "priority capacity reservations" tied to Dedicated pools. This invoice is for Private deployment though. Asking them for credit and evidence of signed AP.

Maria (Finance): Decision proposal: place invoice on hold and open dispute; notify customer that we're investigating. @Alex (Finance Lead) can you approve the hold?

Alex (Finance Lead): Approve hold + dispute. Do not pay until we receive credit or signed amendment. Please cc legal on all replies. :thumbsup:

Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-0421 marked HOLD by Alex. Tag: disputed_by_finance. Notifying AP for stop-pay.

Sam (Sales): I'll push reseller for a credit note and confirm whether an amendment exists. I'll update this thread within 2 hours.

Tina (Customer Success): Thanks — I'll message the customer to let them know we're handling it.

Maria (Finance): Thanks everyone. If reseller refuses, legal and sales to escalate; finance to prepare dispute paperwork. Closing loop when credit issued.
